stem.text: Which statement about the transcription and translation of a gene is correct?

A.text: The non-transcribed strand of DNA has a base sequence that is identical to the mRNA produced in transcription.

B.text: The template strand of DNA has a base sequence that is identical to the mRNA produced in transcription.

C.text: The non-transcribed strand of DNA has a base sequence that is complementary to the tRNA molecules required in translation.

D.text: The template strand of DNA has a base sequence that is complementary to the tRNA molecules required in translation.
